fusions.name: Browbeater
fusions.desc: You pound the ground, dealing 13 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, knocking them back 2.5 tiles and leaving them [Damped] for 5 seconds, their damage lowered.

fusions.name: Sized-Up Hurl
fusions.desc: Hurls a chunk of rubble that hits the first enemy in its path for 28 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health and leaves it [Exposed] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Dominance Display
fusions.desc: Up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles turn on you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Grudge Watch
fusions.desc: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, your physical damage rises by 20% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
